      Review window: Aug 3, 2026 - Aug 3, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _ray lee_, Aug 3, 2026, 3/5: "Between 2026/08/01 and 2026/08/02, Google pay silently stopped to work for many users. Imagine you were at highway toll, groceries, restaurant, travelling and you have no way to pay. A payment method meant to be highly reliable: it pays when it's the time to pay.
